newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - July 3.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - July 3.

text.p: -- SBC Communications Inc filed suit in federal court seeking to overturn provisions in the 1996 telecommunications law restricting Baby Bells from entering long distance telephone markets, a company lawyer said. SBC closed at 60-15/16.
-- General Mills Inc, the second largest U.S. cereal maker, said it plans to increase prices by an average of 2.6 percent, after cutting prices four times since 1993. The stock closed at 65-3/4.
-- SpeedFam International Inc reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.46 per share, flat with a year ago. The stock closed at 37-1/8, then rose to 38 in after-hours trading.
-- Tyco International Inc said it completed its $5.4 billion merger with ADT Ltd. Tyco closed at 75-11/16.
